_comment: Run template for synthetic-hw-plant-cycling (generated by CAMBER, no real building): a hot-water plant's boiler cycling, loop delta-T and pumping, at the trend's own 15-minute resolution. boiler_short_cycle counts firing starts per day from the burner firing (BLR_FIRE; warn at 6, fault at 12); hw_plant_deltat reads the loop delta-T over occupied firing samples (20 F design minimum); hw_pump_dp_reset reads the pump speed and the DP setpoint. Measured: PLANT__well_tuned is ok on all three; PLANT__short_cycling faults on boiler_short_cycle (20.2 starts a day); PLANT__marginal warns on it (8.15); PLANT__low_delta_t faults on hw_plant_deltat and hw_pump_dp_reset. Resampled to 1h the short cycles mostly vanish: keep resample at 15min.
